passages.text: So Isaac called for Jacob and blessed him. “Do not take a wife from the Canaanite women,” he commanded.
passages.sermon:
Isaac was Jacob’s father.
Isaac called Jacob.
Isaac blessed Jacob.
Isaac gave Jacob a command.
Isaac said to Jacob, “Do not take a wife from the Canaanite women.”
passages.original: וַיִּקְרָ֥א יִצְחָ֛ק אֶֽל־ יַעֲקֹ֖ב וַיְבָ֣רֶךְ אֹת֑וֹ וַיְצַוֵּ֙הוּ֙ וַיֹּ֣אמֶר ל֔וֹ לֹֽא־ תִקַּ֥ח אִשָּׁ֖ה מִבְּנ֥וֹת כְּנָֽעַן׃

passages.text: “Go at once to Paddan-aram, to the house of your mother’s father Bethuel, and take a wife from among the daughters of Laban, your mother’s brother.
passages.sermon:
Isaac spoke to Jacob.
Isaac was Jacob’s father.
Isaac told Jacob what to do.
Isaac said, “Get up now.
Go to Paddan-aram.
Go to the house of Bethuel.
Bethuel is your mother’s father.
When you arrive, find Laban.
Laban is your mother’s brother.
Take a wife from the daughters of Laban.”
passages.original: ק֥וּם לֵךְ֙ פַּדֶּ֣נָֽה אֲרָ֔ם בֵּ֥יתָה בְתוּאֵ֖ל אֲבִ֣י אִמֶּ֑ךָ וְקַח־ לְךָ֤ מִשָּׁם֙ אִשָּׁ֔ה מִבְּנ֥וֹת לָבָ֖ן אֲחִ֥י אִמֶּֽךָ׃

passages.text: May God Almighty bless you and make you fruitful and multiply you, so that you may become a company of peoples.
passages.sermon:
Isaac was the father of Jacob.
Isaac spoke to Jacob.
Isaac said, “God Almighty is El Shaddai.”
God Almighty will bless you.
God Almighty will make you fruitful.
God Almighty will make you multiply.
You will become a large group of people.
You will become a community of nations.
passages.original: וְאֵ֤ל שַׁדַּי֙ יְבָרֵ֣ךְ אֹֽתְךָ֔ וְיַפְרְךָ֖ וְיַרְבֶּ֑ךָ וְהָיִ֖יתָ לִקְהַ֥ל עַמִּֽים׃

passages.text: And may He give the blessing of Abraham to you and your descendants, so that you may possess the land where you dwell as a foreigner, the land God gave to Abraham.”
passages.sermon:
Isaac was Jacob’s father.
Isaac spoke to Jacob.
Isaac wanted God to bless Jacob.
Isaac asked God to give Jacob the blessing of Abraham.
Abraham was Jacob’s grandfather.
Isaac wanted this blessing for Jacob and for Jacob’s descendants.
Isaac wanted Jacob and his descendants to receive the land.
Jacob lived in this land as a foreigner.
God gave this land to Abraham.
passages.original: וְיִֽתֶּן־ לְךָ֙ אֶת־ בִּרְכַּ֣ת אַבְרָהָ֔ם לְךָ֖ וּלְזַרְעֲךָ֣ אִתָּ֑ךְ לְרִשְׁתְּךָ֙ אֶת־ אֶ֣רֶץ מְגֻרֶ֔יךָ אֲשֶׁר־ נָתַ֥ן אֱלֹהִ֖ים לְאַבְרָהָֽם׃

passages.text: So Isaac sent Jacob to Paddan-aram, to Laban son of Bethuel the Aramean, the brother of Rebekah, who was the mother of Jacob and Esau.
passages.sermon:
Isaac was the father of Jacob and Esau.
Rebekah was their mother.
Isaac sent Jacob away.
Jacob went to Paddan-aram.
Laban lived in Paddan-aram.
Laban was the son of Bethuel.
Bethuel was an Aramean.
Laban was the brother of Rebekah.
passages.original: וַיִּשְׁלַ֤ח יִצְחָק֙ אֶֽת־ יַעֲקֹ֔ב וַיֵּ֖לֶךְ פַּדֶּ֣נָֽה אֲרָ֑ם אֶל־ לָבָ֤ן בֶּן־ בְּתוּאֵל֙ הָֽאֲרַמִּ֔י אֲחִ֣י רִבְקָ֔ה אֵ֥ם יַעֲקֹ֖ב וְעֵשָֽׂו׃

passages.text: Now Esau learned that Isaac had blessed Jacob and sent him to Paddan-aram to take a wife there, commanding him, “Do not marry a Canaanite woman,” and that Jacob had obeyed his father and mother and gone to Paddan-aram.
passages.sermon:
Isaac was the father of Esau and Jacob.
Jacob was the son of Isaac and Rebekah.
Esau learned something important.
Esau saw that Isaac had blessed Jacob.
Isaac sent Jacob to Paddan-aram.
Isaac told Jacob to take a wife from there.
Isaac commanded Jacob.
Isaac said, “Do not marry a Canaanite woman.”
Jacob listened to his father and mother.
Jacob went to Paddan-aram.
passages.original: וַיַּ֣רְא עֵשָׂ֗ו כִּֽי־ בֵרַ֣ךְ יִצְחָק֮ אֶֽת־ יַעֲקֹב֒ וְשִׁלַּ֤ח אֹתוֹ֙ פַּדֶּ֣נָֽה אֲרָ֔ם לָקַֽחַת־ ל֥וֹ מִשָּׁ֖ם אִשָּׁ֑ה בְּבָרֲכ֣וֹ אֹת֔וֹ וַיְצַ֤ו עָלָיו֙ לֵאמֹ֔ר לֹֽא־ תִקַּ֥ח אִשָּׁ֖ה מִבְּנ֥וֹת כְּנָֽעַן׃ וַיִּשְׁמַ֣ע יַעֲקֹ֔ב אֶל־ אָבִ֖יו וְאֶל־ אִמּ֑וֹ וַיֵּ֖לֶךְ פַּדֶּ֥נָֽה אֲרָֽם׃

passages.text: And seeing that his father Isaac disapproved of the Canaanite women, Esau went to Ishmael and married Mahalath, the sister of Nebaioth and daughter of Abraham’s son Ishmael, in addition to the wives he already had.
passages.sermon:
Esau was the son of Isaac.
Isaac did not approve of the Canaanite women.
Esau saw that his father Isaac disapproved of the Canaanite women.
Esau went to Ishmael.
Ishmael was the son of Abraham.
Esau married Mahalath.
Mahalath was the daughter of Ishmael.
Mahalath was the sister of Nebaioth.
Esau took Mahalath as a wife.
Esau already had other wives.
passages.original: וַיַּ֣רְא עֵשָׂ֔ו כִּ֥י רָע֖וֹת בְּנ֣וֹת כְּנָ֑עַן בְּעֵינֵ֖י יִצְחָ֥ק אָבִֽיו׃ וַיֵּ֥לֶךְ עֵשָׂ֖ו אֶל־ יִשְׁמָעֵ֑אל וַיִּקַּ֡ח אֶֽת־ מָחֲלַ֣ת׀ בַּת־ יִשְׁמָעֵ֨אל בֶּן־ אַבְרָהָ֜ם אֲח֧וֹת נְבָי֛וֹת עַל־ נָשָׁ֖יו ל֥וֹ לְאִשָּֽׁה׃ס

passages.text: Meanwhile Jacob left Beersheba and set out for Haran.
passages.sermon: Jacob was Isaac’s son.\r\nJacob left Beersheba.\r\nJacob traveled toward Haran.
passages.original: וַיֵּצֵ֥א יַעֲקֹ֖ב מִבְּאֵ֣ר שָׁ֑בַע וַיֵּ֖לֶךְ חָרָֽנָה׃

passages.text: On reaching a certain place, he spent the night there because the sun had set. And taking one of the stones from that place, he put it under his head and lay down to sleep.
passages.sermon:
Jacob was traveling from Beersheba to Haran.
He reached a certain place.
The sun had set.
Jacob decided to spend the night there.
He took one of the stones from that place.
He put the stone under his head.
Jacob lay down to sleep in that place.
passages.original: וַיִּפְגַּ֨ע בַּמָּק֜וֹם וַיָּ֤לֶן שָׁם֙ כִּי־ בָ֣א הַשֶּׁ֔מֶשׁ וַיִּקַּח֙ מֵאַבְנֵ֣י הַמָּק֔וֹם וַיָּ֖שֶׂם מְרַֽאֲשֹׁתָ֑יו וַיִּשְׁכַּ֖ב בַּמָּק֥וֹם הַהֽוּא׃

passages.text: And Jacob had a dream about a ladder that rested on the earth with its top reaching up to heaven, and God’s angels were going up and down the ladder.
passages.sermon:
Jacob was the son of Isaac and the grandson of Abraham.
Jacob left Beersheba and traveled toward Haran.
Jacob stopped for the night because the sun had set.
Jacob lay down to sleep in that place.
Jacob had a dream.
In the dream, Jacob saw a ladder.
The ladder stood on the earth.
The top of the ladder reached up to heaven.
God’s angels were on the ladder.
The angels were going up the ladder.
The angels were coming down the ladder.
passages.original: וַֽיַּחֲלֹ֗ם וְהִנֵּ֤ה סֻלָּם֙ מֻצָּ֣ב אַ֔רְצָה וְרֹאשׁ֖וֹ מַגִּ֣יעַ הַשָּׁמָ֑יְמָה וְהִנֵּה֙ מַלְאֲכֵ֣י אֱלֹהִ֔ים עֹלִ֥ים וְיֹרְדִ֖ים בּֽוֹ׃

passages.text: And there at the top the LORD was standing and saying, “I am the LORD, the God of your father Abraham and the God of Isaac. I will give you and your descendants the land on which you now lie.
passages.sermon:
The LORD stood above the ladder in Jacob’s dream.
The LORD spoke to Jacob.
The LORD said, “I am the LORD.
I am the God of your father Abraham.
I am the God of Isaac.
You are lying on this land now.
I will give this land to you.
I will give this land to your descendants.”
passages.original: וְהִנֵּ֨ה יְהוָ֜ה נִצָּ֣ב עָלָיו֮ וַיֹּאמַר֒ אֲנִ֣י יְהוָ֗ה אֱלֹהֵי֙ אַבְרָהָ֣ם אָבִ֔יךָ וֵאלֹהֵ֖י יִצְחָ֑ק הָאָ֗רֶץ אֲשֶׁ֤ר אַתָּה֙ שֹׁכֵ֣ב עָלֶ֔יהָ לְךָ֥ אֶתְּנֶ֖נָּה וּלְזַרְעֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: Your descendants will be like the dust of the earth, and you will spread out to the west and east and north and south. All the families of the earth will be blessed through you and your offspring.
passages.sermon:
God spoke to Jacob in a dream.
God promised Jacob many descendants.
Jacob’s descendants will be as numerous as the dust of the earth.
Jacob and his descendants will spread out in every direction.
They will go west.
They will go east.
They will go north.
They will go south.
All the families of the earth will receive blessing through Jacob.
All the families of the earth will receive blessing through Jacob’s descendants.
passages.original: וְהָיָ֤ה זַרְעֲךָ֙ כַּעֲפַ֣ר הָאָ֔רֶץ וּפָרַצְתָּ֛ יָ֥מָּה וָקֵ֖דְמָה וְצָפֹ֣נָה וָנֶ֑גְבָּה וְנִבְרֲכ֥וּ בְךָ֛ כָּל־ מִשְׁפְּחֹ֥ת הָאֲדָמָ֖ה וּבְזַרְעֶֽךָ׃

passages.text: Look, I am with you, and I will watch over you wherever you go, and I will bring you back to this land. For I will not leave you until I have done what I have promised you.”
passages.sermon:
The LORD spoke to Jacob.
The LORD said, “I am with you.
I will watch over you wherever you go.
I will bring you back to this land.
I will not leave you.
I will stay with you until I have done what I promised you.”
passages.original: וְהִנֵּ֨ה אָנֹכִ֜י עִמָּ֗ךְ וּשְׁמַרְתִּ֙יךָ֙ בְּכֹ֣ל אֲשֶׁר־ תֵּלֵ֔ךְ וַהֲשִׁ֣בֹתִ֔יךָ אֶל־ הָאֲדָמָ֖ה הַזֹּ֑את כִּ֚י לֹ֣א אֶֽעֱזָבְךָ֔ עַ֚ד אֲשֶׁ֣ר אִם־ עָשִׂ֔יתִי אֵ֥ת אֲשֶׁר־ דִּבַּ֖רְתִּי לָֽךְ׃

passages.text: When Jacob woke up, he thought, “Surely the LORD is in this place, and I was unaware of it.”
passages.sermon:
Jacob was the son of Isaac and the grandson of Abraham.
Jacob had a dream from God while he was traveling.
Jacob woke up from his sleep.
Jacob said, “The LORD is truly in this place.”
Jacob did not know that the LORD was there before.
Jacob realized God’s presence only after he woke up.
passages.original: וַיִּיקַ֣ץ יַעֲקֹב֮ מִשְּׁנָתוֹ֒ וַיֹּ֕אמֶר אָכֵן֙ יֵ֣שׁ יְהוָ֔ה בַּמָּק֖וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה וְאָנֹכִ֖י לֹ֥א יָדָֽעְתִּי׃

passages.text: And he was afraid and said, “How awesome is this place! This is none other than the house of God; this is the gate of heaven!”
passages.sermon:
Jacob was afraid.
Jacob spoke.
Jacob said, “This place is awesome.”
This place is the house of God.
This place is the gate of heaven.
passages.original: וַיִּירָא֙ וַיֹּאמַ֔ר מַה־ נּוֹרָ֖א הַמָּק֣וֹם הַזֶּ֑ה אֵ֣ין זֶ֗ה כִּ֚י אִם־ בֵּ֣ית אֱלֹהִ֔ים וְזֶ֖ה שַׁ֥עַר הַשָּׁמָֽיִם׃

passages.text: Early the next morning, Jacob took the stone that he had placed under his head, and he set it up as a pillar. He poured oil on top of it, and he called that place Bethel, though previously the city had been named Luz.
passages.sermon:
Jacob was a man chosen by God.
Jacob woke up early in the morning.
He took the stone he had placed under his head.
He set the stone up as a pillar.
He poured oil on top of the stone.
Jacob named that place Bethel.
The city had been called Luz before.
passages.original: וַיַּשְׁכֵּ֨ם יַעֲקֹ֜ב בַּבֹּ֗קֶר וַיִּקַּ֤ח אֶת־ הָאֶ֙בֶן֙ אֲשֶׁר־ שָׂ֣ם מְרַֽאֲשֹׁתָ֔יו וַיָּ֥שֶׂם אֹתָ֖הּ מַצֵּבָ֑ה וַיִּצֹ֥ק שֶׁ֖מֶן עַל־ רֹאשָֽׁהּ׃ וַיִּקְרָ֛א אֶת־ שֵֽׁם־ הַמָּק֥וֹם הַה֖וּא בֵּֽית־ אֵ֑ל וְאוּלָ֛ם ל֥וּז שֵׁם־ הָעִ֖יר לָרִאשֹׁנָֽה׃

passages.text: Then Jacob made a vow, saying, “If God will be with me and watch over me on this journey, and if He will provide me with food to eat and clothes to wear, so that I may return safely to my father’s house, then the LORD will be my God.
passages.sermon: Jacob was a man chosen by God.\r\nJacob made a vow.\r\nJacob said, “If God is with me, and if God watches over me on this journey I am taking, and if God gives me bread to eat, and if God gives me clothes to wear, and if I return in peace to my father’s house, then the LORD will be my God.”
passages.original: וַיִּדַּ֥ר יַעֲקֹ֖ב נֶ֣דֶר לֵאמֹ֑ר אִם־ יִהְיֶ֨ה אֱלֹהִ֜ים עִמָּדִ֗י וּשְׁמָרַ֙נִי֙ בַּדֶּ֤רֶךְ הַזֶּה֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר אָנֹכִ֣י הוֹלֵ֔ךְ וְנָֽתַן־ לִ֥י לֶ֛חֶם לֶאֱכֹ֖ל וּבֶ֥גֶד לִלְבֹּֽשׁ׃ וְשַׁבְתִּ֥י בְשָׁל֖וֹם אֶל־ בֵּ֣ית אָבִ֑י וְהָיָ֧ה יְהוָ֛ה לִ֖י לֵאלֹהִֽים׃

passages.text: And this stone I have set up as a pillar will be God’s house, and of all that You give me I will surely give You a tenth.”
passages.sermon:
Jacob spoke to God.
Jacob had set up a stone as a pillar.
Jacob said, “This stone will be God’s house.
God, You will give me many things.
I will give You a tenth of everything You give me.”
passages.original: וְהָאֶ֣בֶן הַזֹּ֗את אֲשֶׁר־ שַׂ֙מְתִּי֙ מַצֵּבָ֔ה יִהְיֶ֖ה בֵּ֣ית אֱלֹהִ֑ים וְכֹל֙ אֲשֶׁ֣ר תִּתֶּן־ לִ֔י עַשֵּׂ֖ר אֲעַשְּׂרֶ֥נּוּ לָֽךְ׃
